evals.prompt: fetch and rebase my branch, I need to get the latest from origin before I open a PR
evals.expected_output: Fetches from origin, shows divergence (commits behind/ahead), and rebases the current branch onto the upstream tracking branch. Reports rebase result. Does NOT push.
expectations: fetches latest refs from origin
shows how many commits the branch is behind and ahead
rebases the current branch onto the updated upstream
preserves local commits on top of upstream changes
does NOT push to remote after rebasing

evals.prompt: pull --rebase from main, I want a clean linear history
evals.expected_output: Recognizes pull --rebase as a fetch-rebase intent. Fetches from origin, rebases onto origin/main, and reports the result without pushing.
expectations: recognizes 'pull --rebase' as a fetch-rebase intent for the fr skill
fetches from origin and rebases onto origin/main
does NOT create merge commits, maintaining linear history
does NOT push after the rebase

evals.expected_output: Uses 'upstream' as the remote and 'release/2.0' as the target branch. Fetches from upstream and rebases onto upstream/release/2.0.
expectations: uses 'upstream' as the remote instead of origin
targets 'release/2.0' as the branch to rebase onto
fetches from the upstream remote before rebasing
rebases current branch onto upstream/release/2.0

evals.prompt: rebase onto latest main, I have some uncommitted changes in src/api.go that I don't want to lose
evals.expected_output: Detects uncommitted changes. Offers three options: stash and continue, abort, or proceed anyway. If stashing, restores stashed changes after successful rebase.
expectations: detects uncommitted changes via git status --porcelain
offers options: stash and continue, abort, or proceed anyway
if stashing, runs git stash push before rebase and git stash pop after
does NOT silently discard uncommitted work
warns about potential conflicts with stashed changes

evals.prompt: hey I need to rebase my feature/payments branch onto main, there's probably going to be conflicts in the checkout controller
evals.expected_output: Proceeds with fetch and rebase. If conflicts occur, lists conflicted files, explains conflict markers, and provides commands for --continue or --abort. Does NOT push.
expectations: proceeds with fetch and rebase despite anticipated conflicts
if conflicts occur, lists the conflicted files
provides guidance on resolving conflicts with git add and git rebase --continue
explains how to abort with git rebase --abort
does NOT push after rebase, even if successful

evals.prompt: update my feature branch with the latest from main, I've got 12 commits that need to go on top
evals.expected_output: Fetches latest main from remote, rebases the feature branch onto origin/main so all 12 local commits are replayed on top. Reports the number of commits replayed.
expectations: fetches latest main from origin
rebases the current feature branch onto origin/main
replays local commits on top of the updated main
reports the number of commits replayed and new HEAD position

evals.prompt: fr my branch, it should already be up to date with origin
evals.expected_output: Fetches from origin, checks for new upstream commits, and informs the user the branch is already up to date. Skips the rebase since no new changes exist.
expectations: fetches from origin to verify current state
checks git log for new upstream commits not in the local branch
informs the user the branch is already up to date
does NOT perform an unnecessary rebase when already current
